findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - removing the built-in projects feature from a Python starter.
The new list tells the worker to keep the feature's lines in test_module_schemas.py, but that file also calls the projects API at src/forge/templates/starter-python/apps/api/tests/test_module_schemas.py:42 and :48. The checker matches those calls under src/forge/feature_remove.py:93, so keeping them prevents the required all-clear. This is a conflict in the newly delivered list: src/forge/worker.py:61 also tells the worker not to read the coordinator guide, where the database-test exception appears. Specify that the schema inventory stays while the removed API calls must change.
findings.title: Distinguish retained schema entries from removed API calls

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
When an existing non-starter app removes a feature through a fix whose Done line simply says the feature is removed, this brief gives no instruction to search for its name or run the app's build and tests. The coordinator guide has that fallback, but src/forge/worker.py:61 forbids the worker from reading it, and the starter-only paragraph does not tell the worker to run the command that would print the refusal guidance. Include the non-starter path in the delivered worker instructions.
findings.title: Follow-up: Deliver the non-starter fallback to workers

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
For a no-backend prototype with sample_data = true, the new non-starter guidance says to run the app's tests, while src/forge/worker.py:46-49 explicitly tells its worker not to add or run automated tests. The same conflict appears in the general removal steps at line 774. The removal flow needs an applicable proof instruction for sample mode so the agent is not given incompatible directions.
findings.title: Follow-up: Reconcile removal testing with sample mode
